question: According to ICMR-NIN 2020 guidelines, the recommended dietary allowance (RDA) for protein for a sedentary adult Indian is 0.83 g/kg/day.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. The ICMR-NIN 2020 dietary guidelines revised the protein RDA to 0.83 g/kg/day for sedentary adults, replacing the older 1 g/kg/day recommendation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA for protein is 0.83 g/kg/day for sedentary adults — lower than the older 1 g/kg/day figure and based on nitrogen balance studies in Indian populations.
